# openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata Ingestion Pipeline (an "agent" in the OpenMetadata 2.x UI). One resource covers every workflow type: metadata, usage, lineage, profiler, auto classification, data quality (TestSuite), dbt, and so on. The resource only manages the pipeline definition; it does not deploy it to the ingestion runner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The resource only manages the pipeline definition; it does not deploy it to
# the ingestion runner. Deploy from the OpenMetadata UI or API.

resource "openmetadata_database_service" "postgres" {
  name         = "ProductionPostgres"
  service_type = "Postgres"

  connection_json = jsonencode({
    config = {
      type     = "Postgres"
      scheme   = "postgresql+psycopg2"
      username = "readonly_user"
      hostPort = "db.example.com:5432"
      database = "production"
    }
  })
}

# ── Minimal metadata pipeline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# `service` is resolved by name to the UUID the API expects, so referencing
# `.name` of a managed service also creates the implicit dependency.

resource "openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline" "metadata" {
  name          = "postgres_metadata"
  pipeline_type = "metadata"
  service = {
    type = "databaseService"
    name = openmetadata_database_service.postgres.name
  }

  # The structure of the source config depends on `pipeline_type`. See the JSON
  # schemas for each workflow:
  # https://github.com/open-metadata/OpenMetadata/tree/main/openmetadata-spec/src/main/resources/json/schema/metadataIngestion
  source_config_json = jsonencode({
    config = {
      type = "DatabaseMetadata"
    }
  })
}

# ── Scheduled pipeline with filters, retries and ownership ────────────────────

resource "openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline" "metadata_scheduled" {
  name         = "postgres_metadata_hourly"
  display_name = "Postgres metadata (hourly)"
  description  = "Ingests table and column metadata from the production Postgres every hour."

  pipeline_type = "metadata"
  service = {
    type = "databaseService"
    name = openmetadata_database_service.postgres.name
  }

  source_config_json = jsonencode({
    config = {
      type                = "DatabaseMetadata"
      markDeletedTables   = true
      includeTables       = true
      includeViews        = true
      schemaFilterPattern = { includes = ["^public$", "^analytics$"] }
      tableFilterPattern  = { excludes = ["^tmp_.*"] }
    }
  })

  airflow_config = {
    schedule_interval = "0 * * * *" # cron format; leave unset for manual runs only
    retries           = 3
    retry_delay       = 300 # seconds
    pipeline_catchup  = false
  }

  logger_level           = "INFO" # DEBUG | INFO | WARN | ERROR
  raise_on_error         = true
  enable_streamable_logs = true

  domains = ["Engineering"]

  owners = [
    {
      id   = openmetadata_team.data_engineering.id
      type = "team"
    }
  ]
}

resource "openmetadata_team" "data_engineering" {
  name      = "DataEngineering"
  team_type = "Group"
}

# ── Other workflow types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# One resource covers every workflow type. Pick the matching `pipeline_type` and
# `source_config_json.config.type`:
#
#   metadata            DatabaseMetadata
#   usage               DatabaseUsage
#   lineage             DatabaseLineage
#   profiler            Profiler
#   autoClassification  AutoClassification

resource "openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline" "profiler" {
  name          = "postgres_profiler"
  pipeline_type = "profiler"
  service = {
    type = "databaseService"
    name = openmetadata_database_service.postgres.name
  }

  source_config_json = jsonencode({
    config = {
      type               = "Profiler"
      generateSampleData = true
    }
  })

  airflow_config = {
    schedule_interval = "0 2 * * *" # nightly at 02:00
    pipeline_timezone = "UTC"
  }
}

# ── Import ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Import by fully qualified name (<service>.<pipeline>):
#
#   terraform import openmetadata_ingestion_pipeline.metadata ProductionPostgres.postgres_metadata
#
# `source_config_json` is not read back from the API (OpenMetadata fills in
# defaults when storing it), so after an import set it in your configuration
# and apply once. Drift in it is not detected.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name identifying the resource.
- `pipeline_type` (String) Workflow type of the pipeline. One of: `metadata`, `usage`, `lineage`, `profiler`, `autoClassification`, `TestSuite`, `dataInsight`, `elasticSearchReindex`, `dbt`, `application`.
- `service` (Attributes) The entity the pipeline ingests from, usually a service. The provider resolves it by name to the UUID the OpenMetadata API expects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service))
- `source_config_json` (String) The pipeline `sourceConfig` as a JSON string, e.g. `{"config":{"type":"DatabaseMetadata"}}`. The structure depends on `pipeline_type`. OpenMetadata fills in defaults when it stores the config, so this value is not read back from the API and drift in it is not detected.

### Optional

- `airflow_config` (Attributes) Scheduling and runtime settings of the pipeline. Unset fields take the OpenMetadata defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--airflow_config))
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the resource.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains this resource belongs to.
- `enable_streamable_logs` (Boolean) Stream the ingestion logs to the OpenMetadata server while the pipeline runs.
- `logger_level` (String) Logging level of the workflow. One of: `DEBUG`, `INFO`, `WARN`, `ERROR`.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `raise_on_error` (Boolean) Mark the workflow as failed if processing errors are encountered.

### Read-Only

- `deployed` (Boolean) True once the pipeline has been deployed to the ingestion runner. Read-only.
- `enabled` (Boolean) True if the pipeline runs on its next schedule, false if it is paused.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the resource.
- `id` (String) UUID of the resource assigned by OpenMetadata.

<a id="nestedatt--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service`

Required:

- `name` (String) Fully qualified name of the service (for services this is the service name).
- `type` (String) Entity type of the service. One of: `apiService`, `dashboardService`, `databaseService`, `driveService`, `messagingService`, `metadataService`, `mlmodelService`, `pipelineService`, `searchService`, `storageService`, `testSuite`.


<a id="nestedatt--airflow_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `airflow_config`

Optional:

- `concurrency` (Number) Concurrency of the pipeline.
- `email` (String) Email address to notify about the workflow status.
- `max_active_runs` (Number) Maximum number of active runs.
- `pause_pipeline` (Boolean) Pause the pipeline from running once deployed.
- `pipeline_catchup` (Boolean) Run past executions if the start date is in the past.
- `pipeline_timezone` (String) Timezone the schedule is evaluated in.
- `retries` (Number) Number of retries in case of failure.
- `retry_delay` (Number) Delay between retries, in seconds.
- `schedule_interval` (String) Schedule in cron format, e.g. `0 * * * *`. Leave unset for a pipeline that is only run manually.
- `workflow_timeout` (Number) Timeout of the workflow, in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner entity (user or team).
